goals: Verify that the application server correctly serves the index and signout HTML pages
Verify that the MSAL authentication configuration is properly defined with valid credentials and the index page contains the correct MSAL CDN link
activities: Set the global document HTML to the 'index.html' content
Verify the 'src' attribute of the 'load-msal' element contains the MSAL CDN link
Load the MSAL configuration object into the global scope
Verify the MSAL configuration object is defined
Verify the client ID in the configuration matches a valid GUID format
Verify the authority URI in the configuration matches a valid URI format
Set the Node environment variable to 'test'
Send a GET request to the root ('/') endpoint
Verify the root endpoint response status code is 200
Verify the root endpoint response text matches the 'index.html' content
Send a GET request to the '/signout' endpoint
Verify the '/signout' endpoint response status code is 200
Verify the '/signout' endpoint response text matches the 'signout.html' content
